# FlameLink — standalone exhaust flame kit (CM Performance)

> FlameLink is a bolt-on automotive exhaust flame kit that produces real,
> controllable exhaust flames with NO ECU flash, NO tune, and NO engine
> modifications. It is fully standalone — its own controller, fuel delivery
> and ignition, acting entirely in the exhaust, downstream of the engine —
> and fully reversible. Not affiliated with flamelink.io (a CMS product).

## Product facts

- Product line: two models, by CM Performance —
  1. FlameLink ($499): universal, fits any 12V car; flames fire from a
     momentary flame button mounted on the dash — the driver triggers them
  2. FlameLink Pro ($650): engineered for BMW F & G Series; a plug-in
     vehicle-specific harness reads the car and fires flames automatically
     on every throttle lift-off and downshift — no button needed
- Both models: flame size, intensity and crackle are tuned from a phone app;
  multiple saved profiles from subtle daily crackle to full send
- Engine separation: never reflashes, controls or changes the factory ECU
  calibration; flames happen downstream in the exhaust. FlameLink Pro reads
  vehicle signals only to trigger the standalone flame system
- Built-in safety: hard burn-time limits, hardware watchdog, fused power,
  instant output cut on any fault, sealed gasoline feed (no open fuel)
- Fitment: FlameLink is designed for 12V cars, with exact fitment confirmed
  before payment; FlameLink Pro fits BMW F & G Series with a plug-in harness
- Price: FlameLink $499, FlameLink Pro $650 (USD, complete kits); optional
  professional installation $150 on either model
- Ordering: free reservation (no payment online) at
  https://cm-perf.github.io/flink/#order — the team confirms each build,
  price and timeline personally before any payment
- Kits are hand-assembled and bench-tested, built to order in small batches
- Intended use: off-road and show use only

## Why it exists

Most bolt-on flame kits work by cutting ignition and dumping fuel through the
engine — which stresses the engine and does not work on modern cars whose ECU
cuts injection when it detects missing ignition events. Flame tunes (ECU
reflashes) force flames at the cost of engine heat, stress, warranty and
resale value. FlameLink avoids both by being a self-contained system in the
exhaust: the same show without using the engine to create the effect.
